summary: Uber Technologies filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a Term Loan Credit Agreement to finance its previously announced voluntary public takeover offer for Delivery Hero SE. The agreement provides senior unsecured term loans in two tranches maturing 18 months and 3 years after closing, with EURIBOR-based interest and ratings-linked margins. Proceeds will fund the offer, refinance Delivery Hero debt, and pay transaction costs. The bridge facility commitments were reduced by €4 billion. The board recommendation and advisors are not named; the transaction remains subject to regulatory approvals.
